subject.title: fix(qa): use immutable Crabline smoke artifacts

question: Should this PR wait for and pin the Crabline release containing the immutable artifact result fields?
rationale: The central behavior depends on upstream code present on Crabline main but absent from every package OpenClaw can currently install.

options.title: Publish and pin first
options.body: Release the upstream contract, update OpenClaw’s dependency and lockfile, and validate the integrated behavior before merge.

options.title: Land staged consumer code
options.body: Merge before the dependency release and explicitly accept that current installs retain the legacy artifact behavior until follow-up work.

recommendation.title: Publish and pin first
recommendation.body: Release the upstream contract, update OpenClaw’s dependency and lockfile, and validate the integrated behavior before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored both sides of the cross-repository contract and are best positioned to coordinate its release and pin.
